name: plotune-stream
description: Plotune Stream MCP connection plus a safe-use orientation skill for querying engineering event history, dashboards and analytics.

interface.longDescription: Connects to the Plotune Stream MCP server at stream.plotune.net and teaches the safe workflow: choose the project, discover events before querying, keep queries bounded and credit-aware, and confirm before changing webhooks or the data catalog.
defaultPrompt: Which Plotune Stream projects can I use, and what events does the selected project record?
Show the latest events for my project from the last 24 hours, bounded to 100 results.
Build a funnel of my device sessions and show where they drop off.
